protocols.name: Thawing Competent Cells
protocols.description: Thaw a tube of NEB 10-beta Competent E. coli cells on ice for 10 minutes.

protocols.name: DNA Addition
protocols.description: Add 1-5 µl containing 1 pg-100 ng of plasmid DNA to the cell mixture.

protocols.name: Mixing Cells and DNA
protocols.description: Carefully flick the tube 4-5 times to mix cells and DNA. Do not vortex.

parameters.name: flicks
parameters.description: Number of times to flick the tube

protocols.name: Ice Incubation
protocols.description: Place the mixture on ice for 30 minutes. Do not mix.

protocols.name: Heat Shock
protocols.description: Heat shock at exactly 42°C for exactly 30 seconds.

protocols.name: Post Heat Shock Ice Incubation
protocols.description: Place on ice for 5 minutes. Do not mix.

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Temperature for post heat shock incubation

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration of post heat shock incubation

protocols.name: Outgrowth Medium Addition
protocols.description: Pipette 950 µl of room temperature NEB 10-beta/Stable Outgrowth Medium into the mixture.

protocols.name: Outgrowth Incubation
protocols.description: Place at 37°C for 60 minutes, shaking vigorously (250 rpm) or rotating.

protocols.name: Plate Preparation
protocols.description: Warm selection plates to 37°C.

protocols.name: Cell Mixing
protocols.description: Mix the cells thoroughly by flicking the tube and inverting.

protocols.name: Serial Dilution
protocols.description: Perform several 10-fold serial dilutions in NEB 10-beta/Stable Outgrowth Medium.

protocols.name: Plate Spreading
protocols.description: Spread 50-100 µl of each dilution onto a selection plate.

parameters.name: volume spread
parameters.description: Volume of sample spread per plate

protocols.name: Incubation
protocols.description: Incubate overnight at 37°C.

results.title: "Isolating Specific Cell Subsets Directly from Whole Blood Without Columns or Magnets"

protocols.name: Sample Preparation
protocols.description: Ensure sample and reagents are at room temperature

protocols.name: Add RosetteSep™ cocktail
protocols.description: Add RosetteSep™ cocktail to the sample and mix well

protocols.name: Incubation
protocols.description: Incubate the sample with RosetteSep™ cocktail at room temperature

protocols.name: Dilution
protocols.description: Dilute the sample with an equal volume of PBS + 2% FBS

protocols.name: Layering on Density Gradient Medium
protocols.description: Layer the diluted sample on top of the density gradient medium

protocols.name: Centrifugation
protocols.description: Centrifuge at 1200 x g for 20 minutes at room temperature

protocols.name: Cell Recovery
protocols.description: Remove enriched cells from the density gradient medium:plasma interface

protocols.name: Wash 1
protocols.description: Wash enriched cells with PBS + 2% FBS

protocols.name: Ammonium Chloride Lysis
protocols.description: Remove residual red blood cells using ammonium chloride lysis

protocols.name: Wash 2
protocols.description: Second wash of enriched cells with PBS + 2% FBS
